load.rule: steps by planned_ns; sent = first attempts written (sent_ns set); unsent = planned − sent; generator_limited: step p99 of sent_ns − planned_ns over every planned first attempt, an unwritten one counting above any bound, > 5 ms (§B9)

unexpected_errors.rule: attempt-1 requests (§B9): a transport error or timeout (no HTTP response), or a 5xx other than service_aborted_after_acquire whose wall-clock span, from its write to its response, overlaps no fault window [start_ns, end_ns + P]; steps count their observation window: the step minus its first 5 s, by planned_ns

timing.rule: limiter_ns by acquire result (every result other than allowed, limited and degraded is an error); db_ns where the DB work ran (db_ns > 0); refund_ns = final_mono_ns − release_mono_ns; end_to_end_ns from gen.jsonl, attempt 1 with an HTTP response, by status (success 200, limited 429, error other), retries apart; steps: the §B9 latency population over each observation window; rewrite: attempt-1 responses whose wall-clock span overlaps a rewrite window (TRF-S7)

fields.context.start_ns, end_ns, faults[].start: wall clock, ns since the UTC epoch
fields.api request arrival_ns: wall clock, ns since the UTC epoch
fields.samples t_ns: wall clock, ns since the UTC epoch
fields.api decision_ns, request decision_ns, ge: budget time: the store's clock in µs × 1,000 (API-4); compared only with budget time
fields.refund credit_decision_ns: budget time: the store's clock in µs × 1,000 (API-4); compared only with budget time
fields.gen planned_ns, sent_ns: hitgen's monotonic clock, ns from its t0
fields.release release_mono_ns: hitapi's monotonic clock, ns since the process started
fields.refund release_mono_ns, final_mono_ns: the limiter's monotonic clock, ns since it was built

clocks.t0_rule: hitgen's t0 on the wall clock: the time of its sending log line (hitgen.stderr), written just before it takes t0; it places planned_ns and sent_ns on the wall clock for the fault and rewrite windows and arrival_ns on hitgen's steps

log_drops.detail: log_drops summed over every stop and pre_kill line of every api-N.jsonl

listener_drops.detail: HAR-13: listener_drops summed over every stop and pre_kill line is 0, every pre_kill read succeeded (read_ok), and every process segment holds one of the two, not necessarily as its last line

fixtures_off.detail: benchmark runs: every /health read shows fixtures false on the store clock, at least one was read, and no fault ran

outage.detail: every store outage measured (context.json outage_ns of each faultctl store down or pause that ran) and at most 5 s

outage_segments.detail: store outage segments armed: faultctl store down or pause, and store refusals that are timed (a duration_ms above 0) or unbounded (neither count nor duration_ms)

gen_summary.detail: gen.jsonl ends with its summary line, whose log_drops is 0

rewrite_windows.detail: a scenario with forced_aof_rewrites_s observed at least one AOF rewrite window

correctness.detail: HAR-13: refmodel.check_bud11's BUD-11a verdict (correctness) is pass or violation, not invalid: an invalid verdict means the run's refund evidence is incomplete (invalid_reasons say why; rerun)
